name: io.github.drQedwards/pmll-memory-mcp
title: PMLL Memory MCP
description: Short-term KV context memory and Q-promise deduplication for Claude agent tasks via peek().

environmentVariables.name: PMLL_SILO_SIZE
environmentVariables.description: Number of KV slots in the PMLL memory silo per session. Defaults to 256.

environmentVariables.name: PMLL_SESSION_TTL
environmentVariables.description: Time-to-live in seconds for memory sessions. Defaults to 3600.
